# HiddenTopologyReveal

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of uncovering non-obvious topological structures (e.g., high-dimensional loops or voids) in complex systems that are invisible to standard analysis, using optimal persistence methods. This is essential for iNEST systems to identify latent computational pathways and memory structures in neuromorphic hardware, improving learning and adaptability.
